project: Frontend Design Global Skills and Workflow

tasks.name: Initialize the loop package
tasks.description: Create the durable loop files, task queue, progressive-disclosure specs, and initial progress evidence.
acceptance_criteria: GOAL.md contains the mission, goal, verification, loop contract, hard rules, and file map.
tasks.json parses as valid JSON and includes the full build queue.
progress.txt is initialized as append-only memory.
FIRST_START.md, SUBTASKS.md, and every mapped spec file exist.
tasks.verification: parse tasks.json and inspect all paths named in the GOAL.md file map
tasks.notes: Created the minimum loop package plus workflow-, skills-, and copy-specific specs.

tasks.name: Upgrade product-prd-spec
tasks.description: Expand the global PRD skill to discover the full vision, frontend behavior, backend implications, scenarios, and founder approval while remaining product-general.
acceptance_criteria: The skill distinguishes full vision, first coherent frontend experience, and non-goals.
The discovery workflow covers actors, frontend walkthroughs, backend implications, data, permissions, async work, privacy, and failure recovery.
The package creates a PRD, PDF when document tooling is available, user stories, screens, and Given/When/Then scenarios.
The skill defines an explicit founder approval gate and passes validation.
tasks.verification: run quick_validate.py and inspect the PRD and JSON contracts for required fields
tasks.notes: Expanded the global skill with founder walkthrough discovery, full-vision versus first-experience scope, frontend behavior, backend implications, PRD/PDF/story/screen/scenario outputs, a v2 shared screen contract, and an explicit approval gate. quick_validate.py: Skill is valid; placeholder scan passed.

tasks.name: Install and adapt copywriting
tasks.description: Install the Corey Haines copywriting skill globally and extend it for company context, screen copy, a copy manifest, and company/voice.md.
acceptance_criteria: The upstream copywriting skill is installed globally with its references intact.
The customized skill reads company context, PRD artifacts, screen definitions, and wireframes when present.
The skill creates company/voice.md and exact screen/page copy artifacts without inventing proof.
The skill passes validation and its upstream provenance is documented in SKILL.md.
tasks.verification: run quick_validate.py and inspect voice/copy contract fields and upstream source metadata
tasks.notes: Installed coreyhaines31/marketingskills copywriting globally with copy-frameworks, natural-transitions, and evals intact. Customized SKILL.md records upstream 2.0.1/MIT provenance and adds company context, product UI copy, company/voice.md, copy-manifest.json, approval, and exact-copy rules. quick_validate.py and eval JSON parse passed.

tasks.name: Create product-ux-design
tasks.description: Create a global skill for IA, navigation, flows, deterministic grayscale HTML wireframes, responsive screenshots, and screens.json updates.
acceptance_criteria: The skill supports marketing pages and application UI without changing approved product scope.
Wireframes are semantic, responsive grayscale HTML and CSS with deterministic PNG screenshots.
Relume MCP is an optional component source, not a required dependency.
The skill updates every screen wireframe path and passes validation.
tasks.verification: run quick_validate.py and use the bundled validator against a fixture HTML wireframe and screens.json
tasks.notes: Created the global product-ux-design skill with IA, navigation, flow, HTML wireframe, optional Relume, and screens handoff references; reusable grayscale HTML/CSS assets; deterministic Playwright renderer; and a Python validator. quick_validate.py passed. Renderer produced 1440px desktop and 390px mobile PNGs; validator accepted the complete fixture and rejected the incomplete fixture; visual inspection confirmed neutral low-fidelity structure.

tasks.name: Create product-screen-mockups
tasks.description: Create a global skill that turns approved wireframe PNGs, copy, and brand context into consistent ImageGen raster mockups and interaction handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: The skill requires approved wireframe screenshots and copy artifacts before generation.
The skill uses imagegen-frontend-web direction plus built-in ImageGen for every final mockup.
The skill preserves structure, handles application UI and marketing pages, and treats copy manifests as canonical.
The skill updates screens.json, documents interactions, and passes validation.
tasks.verification: run quick_validate.py and inspect the generation, QA, state, and artifact contracts
tasks.notes: Created the global product-screen-mockups skill with approved-input gates, marketing versus application UI direction, ImageGen reference/prompt rules, raster QA, mockup and interaction contracts, and a deterministic manifest validator. quick_validate.py and Python compilation passed. The validator accepted a complete fixture and rejected an invalid fixture that used HTML screenshot provenance, mismatched state, missing references, and incomplete QA.

tasks.name: Write the reusable frontend workflow
tasks.description: Document the four skill stages, approval gates, artifacts, backend boundary, resume behavior, and completion criteria for company projects.
acceptance_criteria: WORKFLOW.md defines PRD, UX, copywriting, and mockup stages in order.
Each stage names inputs, outputs, approval gates, verification, and resume behavior.
The workflow clearly separates frontend definition from downstream backend architecture and implementation.
The workflow is runnable by a fresh agent without this chat history.
tasks.verification: manual contract review plus link and path checks
tasks.notes: Created WORKFLOW.md as a fresh-agent-runnable contract with global dependencies, canonical artifact paths, four ordered stages, exact inputs/actions/outputs/validation, founder approval gates, resume behavior, engineering handoff criteria, and a clear boundary between frontend implications and backend architecture.

tasks.name: Run integrated validation
tasks.description: Validate all global skills, JSON contracts, loop files, workflow paths, and handoffs as one system.
acceptance_criteria: All four skills pass quick_validate.py.
All loop and workflow JSON files parse successfully.
Cross-skill artifact names and paths agree.
No placeholders, conflict markers, accidental local skill copies, or broken workflow links remain.
tasks.verification: execute every command in spec/verification.md and record the combined result
tasks.notes: All four global skills passed quick_validate.py and contain SKILL.md plus agents/openai.yaml. Referenced resources resolved; workflow JSON parsed; no placeholders, conflict markers, .DS_Store files, or local skill copies were found; git diff --check passed. Shared screen/copy/mockup contract terms agree. UX and mockup validators each accepted complete fixtures and rejected incomplete or invalid provenance/state/reference fixtures. Manual workflow review answered stage inputs/outputs, gates, wireframe method, canonical copy, ImageGen method, and engineering boundary.

acceptance_criteria: company/plan.md reflects the new frontend-definition workflow and its next action.
company/activity.md and company/run-log.md contain correctly sequenced entries.
Talisha's profile records only explicitly demonstrated durable collaboration preferences.
tasks.verification: inspect note numbering, timestamps, plan checkboxes, and collaborator profile scope
tasks.notes: Updated company/plan.md with the completed reusable workflow, next PRD action, and four durable workflow decisions. Appended note-0006 and three chronologically ordered run-log entries. Added collaborators/talisha-voice.md with explicitly demonstrated preferences only. Added AGENTS.md lesson 5 after the zsh path-variable incident. Format, numbering, decision, profile-scope, and diff checks passed.

tasks.name: Commit and push the feature branch
tasks.description: Run final repository checks, create a conventional commit, and push the verified feature branch.
acceptance_criteria: The repository worktree is free of unrelated or generated junk files.
All repository changes are committed with a Conventional Commit subject.
The feature branch is pushed to origin and the working tree is clean.
